verses.1: The words that came from Jehovah to Jeremiah, when King Zedekiah sent Pashhur son of Malchiah and Tsanphaniya son of Maasiyah to him.
verses.2: Please seek help from Jehovah for us. For the king of Babylon will fight against us. But may Jehovah do to us whatever He desires, and may He rise above us.
verses.3: And Jeremiah said to them, “Thus shall you say to Tzidkiah.”
verses.4: As the LORD, the God of Israel, says: “I will destroy all those who are involved in warfare against you. You will be able to defeat King Babylon and all those who are attacking you from outside the city. I will gather them all inside this city.”
verses.5: And I will fight against you with my strong arms, with my sharp teeth, with my fangs, and with my fierce anger.
verses.6: And I took away the inhabitants of this city, as well as the people and animals. All of them were destroyed by my great words.
verses.7: And after that, Jehovah will give me the reigns of Judah and its people, as well as those who remain in this city. These will be freed from the oppression of Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, and from their enemies. They will not be harmed or oppressed by him.
verses.8: And to this people, he will say, “As the LORD says: ‘I will show you the way of life, and also the way of death.’”
verses.9: He who lived in this city died due to war, famine, and disease. He was killed by the cruel people who lived there. His soul was left to suffer forever.
verses.10: For I have turned my face against this city for evil, not for good. Say, “The LORD has done it through the hand of Babylon.” They will burn it with fire.
verses.11: And in the house of the king of Judah, they heard the words of Jehovah.
verses.12: David said, “The judgment of the LORD is for tomorrow. He will save those who are in danger from the hands of their enemies. Then fire and destruction will come upon them. But no evil person can escape from the LORD’s hand.”
verses.13: I am here, O LORD, who sit on the throne of judgment. May the words of the LORD be fulfilled: “Who will bring us to judgment, and who will come against us in our troubles?”
verses.14: And I will put fire upon you, as a punishment for your sins. May the LORD do so! I will set fire to the forest, and it will burn down everything around it.
